item_short_desc: Rothco’s Noise Reduction Ear Muffs are essential for hunters, outdoor enthusiasts, and range professionals. With a Noise Reduction Rating (NRR) of 28 (+/- 3db), these ear muffs provide excellent hearing protection from loud sounds, ensuring a safer experience. The lightweight and durable plastic construction make them comfortable to wear for extended periods, while the padded headband enhances long-term comfort. Designed with slide-adjusting earcups, these earmuffs can be customized to fit a wide range of head sizes.
description: Rothco’s Noise Reduction Ear Muffs are essential for hunters, outdoor enthusiasts, and range professionals.
